outcome: No alternative retained reference coverage and workload constraints. Both units fall back to reference; useful financial-crime quality remains unestablished.

source.currency_provenance: USD confirmed by Jevon on 14 October 2026; no FX conversion or IDR valuation.
source.timezone_policy: Unknown source wall-clock values use UTC only as a storage carrier.

selection.slices: all, source-TRAIN-q25 low amounts, every parent group, low amounts per group, every stress recipe, clock-observability slices where available
selection.workload: overall synthetic FP and unlabelled source flags must not increase
rank: maximum precision at retained reference recall
selection.fallback: Reference; a failed improvement is an allowed result

design.validation_group_kind: Three heldout parent groups; one TRAIN-only fit, not k-fold refits
design.independence: Account-disjoint source parents, same source calendar spans; NOT a chronological holdout. Fresh simulated draw from known parent pool/recipe families, not independent real-world crime validation.

train.conditioning_policy: Complete observations and empirical day gaps come from each account's actual source parent in its pre-augmentation partition; global references use TRAIN only. Generated age/occupation is one stable observed pair; source context frequency variation is retained with neutral device/IP IDs.
train.label_policy: Sidecar0/1 labels describe synthetic interventions/background/lookalikes only, not verified legitimacy or crime. No labels or recipe/provenance fields enter transactions.csv or unsupervised fitting.
limitations: Account partitions are independent by source parent but not chronologically disjoint.
Generated clones are dependent augmentations, not new independent real evidence.
Source publisher, augmentation recipe and verified crime targets are unavailable.
Date-only stress cannot establish intraday ordering; supplied minute clocks still lack timezone.
Synthetic stress and benign recipes intentionally overlap; recipe labels are not real financial-crime ground truth.
train.network_policy: No source counterparty graph, ownership or country is inferred. Pass-through remains an alternating-direction account proxy; balance is a recorded snapshot.

simulation_parameters.calendar_gap_rule: Bootstrap parent empirical calendar gaps then span-match that parent's actual observed support; shared hiatus size is sampled from its upper-half positive source gaps.
simulation_parameters.dormancy_rule: Stress and legitimate control select existing interior cadence gaps identically, then retain ordinary follow-up.
simulation_parameters.provenance: Explicit simulation design choices, not FRD/TRD crime thresholds or empirical prevalence.

train.split_policy: Account-group holdout on actual source parents before augmentation; calendar support overlaps. NOT a chronological holdout.
train.timestamp_policy: All generated event dates are simulations within actual parent calendar support. Each bootstrapped source observation retains its day/minute precision; source timezone remains unknown. Day-only rows have no recovered intraday order; all stress rows remain in evaluation.

window.calendar_support: Actual source-parent calendar support, not fixed180-day windows.
